axis: a bare boundary on what one can do → a failing charged against the thing itself

members.tone: Puts the failing inside the thing as something missing or broken, a harder reading of the same deficiency than *shortcoming* gives.
Takes the same failing as falling short of a mark, which leaves the thing whole in a way *defect* does not.
Ties the disadvantage to a subtraction — what is worse now is worse because something is gone — rather than to any flaw.
The plain, unheated name for standing lower or less favourably, stating the position without accusing the thing that holds it.
Locates the trouble in the embarrassment of a situation, so the discomfort is felt rather than the ranked shortfall of *inferiority*.
Sets the thing below its rivals as a matter of competition, judging where *disadvantage* only reports an unfavourable position.
Marks a boundary — limited or restricted — with no failing charged to anyone, which keeps it flatter than *defect*.
Weighs the thing as a hindrance, something in the way of getting on, rather than an emptiness in it as *defect* has.
The heaviest here, since the disadvantage comes as painful consequence earned by an action or condition, not merely suffered.
